title: Reference Frame (Anchor)
description: Well-known anchor points novices can use to orient themselves in time ('Fall of Rome', 'Meiji Restoration', 'Life of Buddha').

year.description: Anchoring year (proleptic Gregorian). Use start year for ranges; add end_year for spans.

anchor_set.description: 'deep-time' covers anchors before the Holocene, where no cultural tradition applies and the reader needs a scale reference rather than a familiar landmark.

summary.description: One-sentence orientation text shown next to the anchor label.

entity_id.description: Optional link to the closest entity in the tree.
